body:
With its beautiful moon-like glow, Selenite gets its name from Selene, the Greek goddess of the Moon. Also called a Selenite skyscraper, the Selenite Tower is one of the most powerful energy tools for clearing, shielding, and protecting the energy of your space. Whether it's placed in your home, office, or sacred space, the Selenite Crystal Tower quickly unblocks negative, stuck or stagnant energy, helping to promote an environment of free flowing positivity.

There are many Selenite Tower benefits, including the ability to shield you from outside influences by evoking protection from your angels in the angelic realm. The wide variety of Selenite Tower uses for your home or other space can be greatly beneficial thanks to its ability to absorb and dispel negative energy, helping to create a peaceful environment of calming frequencies. To get the most Selenite Tower benefits, we personally recommend placing a Selenite tower in each corner of your space, which will create a peaceful, safe and protective environment that won't be disturbed by negative energy or outside influences.

For even more healing energy, you can place other crystals around the Selenite Tower, keeping it as the center point of a healing layout. This powerful Selenite healing grid will seal in the energy while also cleansing and activating other crystals near it, providing a productive shield around your space.

You can also use Selenite Tower benefits in your office or studio space, especially since this crystal point is one of the most powerful tools for setting intentions and manifesting them into the universe. A helpful way for programming your Selenite Tower for a specific use is to hold the crystal in your hands while visualizing your intention, a simple exercise that will program your Selenite to work for you whenever you need it.

Another meaningful way to program your Selenite is to write down your intention on a piece of paper and place it under the tower. Keep it in a place that feels sacred to you, and revisit the crystal whenever you set your intentions for the day.

One of the most powerful protection and cleansing crystals in the mineral kingdom, the Selenite Tower meaning is associated with its unique ability to amplify and raise both the energy of your space and the energy of other healing crystals it touches. When used in a healing capacity, they can generate an unbelievable amount of healing and grounding energy, helping you feel safe and comforted. When placed in a sacred space, the Selenite properties radiating from this angelic looking lamp will cleanse the energy of the room and anything near it, leaving you feeling lighter and more connected with the Earth. Whenever you feel overwhelmed, off-kilter or unbalanced, gaze at your crystal tower and feel the Selenite frequencies surrounding you with 'liquid light,' cleansing your spirit and your environment.
